delegated_execution.review_rule: Each large block receives independent review by a subagent that did not implement it, through contract/identity, durability/concurrency/security, and proof/report/simplification lenses.

DIFF_ATTACK_SURFACES: Contract lens: attacked five-level identity separation, wire strictness, exact-expiry behavior, immutable claim provenance, success-event/key binding, and import membership ambiguity.

Serial durability lens: attacked immediate durable writes, open-time corruption, candidate panic containment, migration phase ordering, activation atomicity, rollback, and store-version/table coupling.
State and recovery lens: attacked stale versus fresh leases, backward reconciliation clocks, row/filesystem divergence, repeat application, foreign canonical-key values, and restart convergence.

Resource and concurrency lens: attacked independent-handle duplicate claims, nondeterministic scheduling, timeout enforcement, bounded generator state, endpoint RSS attribution, and the million-identity opt-in ceiling.
Integration lens: attacked the contract-to-storage-to-testkit-to-xtask manifest chain, source fingerprint closure, scenario/action alignment, report freshness, and model-manual navigation.
Gate and report lens: attacked self-declared counterfactuals, fake restart labels, empty migration evidence, FNV attribution, fabricated B-021 metrics, and semantic overclaims.
INDEPENDENT_CHECKS_RUN: The contract reviewer independently inspected the storage adapter and reproduced exact-expiry mismatch, panic-boundary, migration TOCTOU, foreign-value, replay, and metadata-only-version defects before remediation.

The storage reviewer independently inspected the proof producer and reproduced fake restart, empty migration, nondeterministic concurrency, incomplete source manifest, weak digest, scenario drift, and measurement-overclaim defects before remediation.

The proof reviewer independently inspected the contract layer and reproduced provenance discontinuity, fresh-lease takeover, unbound success events, free-form filesystem labels, ambiguous import membership, backward clocks, and wire-minor identity coupling before remediation.

The parent reran formatting, strict all-target/all-feature Clippy, the canonical full workspace/all-feature/no-fail-fast suite, the standalone archive command, runtime truth, and verify-deep after all reviewer remediations.

The fresh archive report was independently reparsed against its manifest and current five-file SHA-256 source manifest; 24 unique cases yielded 23 semantic passes, one declared blocked scale row, and zero failed cases.
COUNTERFACTUAL_CHECKS: If ArchiveCommitRequest::validate stopped requiring the exact immutable claim provenance, archive::tests::commit_requires_exact_immutable_claim_provenance would accept a foreign claim tuple.
If ArchiveStore migration activation stopped excluding intervening archive writes, storage::tests::migration_blocks_commit_between_verify_and_activate would reproduce the lost-write window.
If reconciliation stopped persisting its applied receipt, the archive corpus repeat would change state instead of proving the same durable idempotent outcome.

If a report row retained PASS after an executed action was removed or its observation changed without a new SHA-256 receipt, testkit::tests::archive_store_evidence_corpus_executes_public_boundary would reject it.
If the B-021 row were promoted from BLOCKED with zero measurements, the independent report validator would reject its summary and measurement contract.
BOUNDARY_PROBES: ArchiveCommitRequest validation binds the contract writer to the storage consumer using the same key, lease token, generation, claim time, expiry, job, transaction, provenance, and output observation.

ArchiveStore decodes every persisted value through its requested canonical key and maps redb failures and caught same-thread corruption unwinds into Ferric-owned typed errors without exposing redb types.
Migration prepare, batch copy, verify, activate, reopen, and rollback cross the public ArchiveStore boundary with exact phase, cursor, counts, digest, version, and table invariants.

The testkit producer executes real independent store handles and close/reopen transitions; the xtask consumer re-reads the persisted report, manifest, current sources, and invocation receipt before acceptance.
The model manual was compared against the exact locked command, report fields, typed recovery behavior, evidence ceiling, and future runtime consumer gate.
NEGATIVE_PATH_CHECKS: Exact lease expiry, rotated or foreign tokens, mismatched generation/provenance, missing filesystem evidence, unknown filesystem profiles, and wrong output IDs fail before archive insertion.
Half-truncated candidate storage returns ArchiveStoreError::OpenFailed without an escaping unwind; the redb panic-hook diagnostic remains explicitly recorded as a candidate residual.

Writes during pre-activation migration, activation after source drift, post-activation rollback, unknown store versions, mismatched table state, interrupted cursors, and foreign canonical-key values fail closed.
Fresh leases, unexpected rows or outputs, backward reconciliation clocks, changed retries, unknown import mappings, and already-imported membership are distinguished with typed outcomes.
Missing actions, forged receipt observations, stale source fingerprints, fabricated scale metrics, and semantic/action drift fail independent report validation.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.finding: Contract review found commit and success semantics could lose or misbind immutable claim provenance and canonical identity context; exact provenance and key-bound regressions now pass.
Storage review found migration activation and reconciliation could admit lost writes, ambiguous version state, or non-idempotent recovery; atomic phase and durable receipt regressions now pass.

Proof review found declared counterfactuals, synthetic restart labels, weak source attribution, and metric overclaims could make evidence look stronger than execution; the public corpus validator now rejects those mutations.

RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: redb 4.1.0 invokes the process panic hook before Ferric catches its reproduced same-thread half-truncated-file assertion; ArchiveStore::open returns typed OpenFailed and no unwind escapes, but redb exposes no safe public API to suppress that diagnostic narrowly.
Clean close/reopen and candidate repair do not prove physical power-loss durability on every filesystem; later staged Ferric execution must re-prove the selected filesystem profile.
B-021 remains honestly BLOCKED unless FFORAGER_RUN_B021=1 supplies the explicit one-million-identity stress budget; the representative workload is not substituted for that result.
This candidate evidence is a prerequisite boundary and does not execute a shipped Ferric download/archive workflow.
